text.arabic_uthmani: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا

words.gloss_range: close sequential and consequential connector prefixed to the reporting verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the reporting verb visibly dependent on the opening connector

supporting_anchors.ar: قُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا
supporting_anchors.tr: qultu istaghfirū rabbakum innahu kāna ghaffāran
supporting_anchors.display: {{ar:قُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا}} ({{tr:qultu istaghfirū rabbakum innahu kāna ghaffāran}})
supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the reported counsel whose onset is bound to the prior outreach

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the ayah begin already attached to the preceding outreach modes in 71:9. The connector is written onto {{ar:قُلْتُ}} ({{tr:qultu}}), but its work is discourse-level: it turns the report of speech into the close next remedial move, not a detached quotation. That hinge also moves the listener from how Noah spoke in 71:9 to what he actually said, and the clipped opening sound latches quickly onto the reporting verb.

topics.headline: close sequence makes counsel the next remedy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reported counsel as the immediate consequential next move after the outreach modes of 71:9, not as loose narration.
topics.reason: QAC treats {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) as a discourse-sequential particle prefixed to {{ar:قُلْتُ}} ({{tr:qultu}}), and the CRITICAL rows coherently read it as close sequence with consequence after 71:9.

topics.headline: boundary pivots from method to message
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verse boundary turn from public and private communication methods into the content of the summons.
topics.reason: The connector stands at the ayah boundary before the quotation frame, so it can preserve the movement from 71:9's modes into 71:10's uttered remedy.

topics.headline: fused clipped onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the transition as a tight latch onto the speech verb before the quotation opens.
topics.reason: The fused proclitic is visible in the surface form and supports a small sound-form payoff without changing the lexical value of {{ar:قُلْتُ}} ({{tr:qultu}}).

words.gloss_range: completed first-person speech report that opens direct quotation
words.root_gloss_range: saying, declaring, and accountable utterance; locally direct reported speech by Noah

supporting_anchors.display: {{ar:ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا}} ({{tr:istaghfirū rabbakum innahu kāna ghaffāran}})
supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the direct quoted counsel introduced by the reporting verb

words.prose: {{ar:قُلْتُ}} ({{tr:qultu}}) packages Noah's counsel as a completed first-person act while letting the embedded imperative remain directly audible. The suffix keeps Noah himself inside the verb, so the remedy is not anonymous advice or passive report; it is accountable speech introduced inside a nested report to God. The q-w-l field makes the counsel an uttered summons, and here that saying concretely introduces {{ar:ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا}} ({{tr:istaghfirū rabbakum innahu kāna ghaffāran}}), joining speech to lordship and forgiveness without making broad co-occurrence data control the local sense. The surah-local movement from speech to the Lord in 71:5 into speech to the people here turns complaint into instruction. Its sharp onset also separates the reporting act from the longer command that follows.

topics.headline: completed first-person counsel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Noah's counsel as a completed, personally owned intervention rather than an anonymous or ongoing report.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form I perfect first common singular verb, and attachment evidence identifies Noah as the continuing speaker of the report.

topics.headline: saying hands off into direct command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the remedy itself, not merely a report that Noah gave advice.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following command and explanation the quoted complement of {{ar:قُلْتُ}} ({{tr:qultu}}), matching the q-w-l speech-act rows.

topics.headline: complaint becomes instruction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the surah's speech spine as Noah's address to his Lord in 71:5 is redirected into remedial address to the people in 71:10.
topics.reason: The same-surah rows give concrete references, especially 71:5 and 71:10, and the local verb genuinely opens the people's quoted instruction.

topics.headline: speech joins lordship and forgiveness fields
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this saying is not random speech: it concretely introduces forgiveness-seeking from the named Lord, while broad co-occurrence data remains only supporting background.
topics.reason: The collocation rows are valid as background because {{ar:قُلْتُ}} ({{tr:qultu}}) locally introduces {{ar:ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:istaghfirū rabbakum}}), but they do not by themselves create an additional local sense.

topics.headline: sharp report before extended command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the compact report land before the longer imperative phrase opens.
topics.reason: The phonetic row gives a secondary but concrete local contrast between the short reporting verb and the following longer command.

words.gloss_range: Form X plural imperative to seek forgiveness from the named Lord
words.root_gloss_range: covering, shielding, pardoning, and forgiveness; locally a command to seek protective pardon from another, not to perform covering oneself

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: direct object/source of the seeking command
final same-root predicate answering the command

words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟}} ({{tr:istaghfirū}}) is the operational center of the quote: a plural imperative, not a description of forgiveness as an idea. Its Form X shape makes the people seekers of covering, directing them to {{ar:رَبَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbakum}}) rather than making them perform the covering themselves. The gh-f-r field keeps forgiveness tactile as protective covering for exposed liability, and the same root returns at the end in {{ar:غَفَّارًۭا}} ({{tr:ghaffāran}}), so human seeking is answered by divine repeated capacity. The command also turns the unstated content of the earlier public and private outreach into a named summons, with 11:52 showing the same phrase shape before promised release and 71:28 showing the surah later perform its own forgiveness appeal.

topics.headline: plural command directed to their Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Noah's remedy is a direct communal obligation aimed at their own Lord, not an abstract teaching about pardon.
topics.reason: QAC gives a second masculine plural Form X imperative, and attachment evidence makes {{ar:رَبَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbakum}}) its explicit object.

topics.headline: forgiveness as sought protective covering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the command as seeking protective covering for exposed fault, while local Form X keeps the selected action as request for pardon.
topics.reason: The broader gh-f-r covering image survives as lexical pressure, but the local verb form and syntax select seeking forgiveness rather than physical covering.

topics.headline: Form X makes pardon sought, not self-produced
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the people placed in the posture of request: they must seek covering from outside themselves instead of generating or already possessing it.
topics.reason: Form X and the explicit object support seeking-from-another, while the rows contrasting Form II and passive forms correctly preserve what the local form does not say.

topics.headline: command stands between report and rationale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah unfold from reported speech into the concrete remedy before the explanatory warrant arrives.
topics.reason: The imperative phrase is the central quoted command, followed by the explanatory {{ar:إِنَّهُ}} ({{tr:innahu}}) clause.

topics.headline: command root returns as divine capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader links the command to seek forgiveness with its same-root answer at the ayah's close, with 11:52 and 71:28 reinforcing the appeal pattern.
topics.reason: The local same-root return to {{ar:غَفَّارًۭا}} ({{tr:ghaffāran}}) is syntactically present, and the cited parallels include concrete references.

topics.headline: gh-f-r sound anticipates closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the consonant frame of the remedy before the final attribute repeats it.
topics.reason: The sound row is local to the repeated gh-f-r frame from command to closing predicate.

words.gloss_range: definite relational Lord as object/source of the seeking command, with second-person plural suffix
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, ownership, nurture, governance, preserving, and bringing to completion; locally the addressed people's own Lord as source of forgiveness

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the imperative whose object is the relational title
the pronoun that resumes the same referent in the rationale
second-person plural possessive suffix that binds the audience to the title
same-surah first-person Lord-language in 71:5 contrasted with the public second-person form

words.prose: {{ar:رَبَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbakum}}) completes the command by naming the source toward whom the seeking is directed: their own Lord. The construct with {{ar:ـكُمْ}} ({{tr:-kum}}) makes the title definite and relational without needing a separate article, so forgiveness is not sourced generically. The r-b-b field keeps nurture and rule together: the one who can cover fault is also the sustaining authority to whom they already belong. The word then hands the same referent into {{ar:إِنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:innahu}}), making the command's object become the rationale's subject, while the surah-local shift from Noah's {{ar:رَبِّ}} ({{tr:rabbī}}) in 71:5 to {{ar:رَبَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbakum}}) turns private appeal into public instruction.

topics.headline: their Lord as the command's destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees forgiveness-seeking directed to a specific already-related Lord, not to an undefined source of relief.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:رَبَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbakum}}) the direct object of the imperative and identifies the suffix as an attached possessor.

topics.headline: nurturing authority sources pardon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the request as return to sustaining authority, while local syntax keeps the selected role on the Lord addressed as object/source of seeking.
topics.reason: The r-b-b root range supplies nurture and governance pressure, but the local word is the relational title in the forgiveness command, not a separate exposition of all lordship branches.

topics.headline: suffix binds the audience to one Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the addressees built into the word itself and the appeal concentrated on one sustaining authority.
topics.reason: The singular construct plus second-person plural suffix is locally visible and supports the contrast with scattered lordship alternatives as a form-level payoff.

topics.headline: object becomes rationale's subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same divine referent from the object of seeking into the subject of the explanatory attribute clause.
topics.reason: Attachment cross-reference evidence resolves the suffix in {{ar:إِنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:innahu}}) back to {{ar:رَبَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbakum}}).

topics.headline: private Lord-language becomes public instruction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Lord-language move from Noah's private appeal in 71:5 into a claim upon the addressed community in 71:10.
topics.reason: The same-surah rows give a concrete shift from 71:5 to 71:10; broader lordship-forgiveness and speech co-occurrence rows support but do not override the local construction.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle with attached pronoun opening the explanatory warrant clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: predicate chain scoped by the emphatic opening
emphatic particle segment governing the attached pronoun
attached third-person pronoun functioning as the governed subject of the emphatic particle

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:innahu}}) pivots from command to reason. The attached {{ar:ـهُ}} ({{tr:-hu}}) resumes {{ar:رَبَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbakum}}) as the explicit subject of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), so the one sought in the command is the same one characterized in the warrant. The particle makes the clause assertive and explanatory at once: {{ar:كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا}} ({{tr:kāna ghaffāran}}) is not a second instruction but the strengthened reason the imperative is coherent. Its compact form fuses certainty and referent tracking before the predicate unfolds.

topics.headline: pronoun makes the Lord the warrant's subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one divine referent continuously from object of seeking to subject of the forgiving attribute.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the suffix as the governed subject of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) and resolves it to {{ar:رَبَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbakum}}).

topics.headline: emphasis turns attribute into reason
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the forgiving attribute as a confirmed rationale for the command, not as a detached devotional statement.
topics.reason: The inna clause is linked by attachment evidence as explanation after the imperative phrase, and its scope runs through the final predicate.

topics.headline: no coordination before the rationale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the clause follow directly as grounding, not as a merely coordinated second statement.
topics.reason: The explanatory clause follows the complete command phrase without an intervening coordinating particle.

topics.headline: compact emphasis and reference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees certainty and pronoun tracking compressed into one hinge before the being-verb.
topics.reason: The fused particle-pronoun form and nasal link to {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) provide a local form-sound payoff without altering the syntax.

words.gloss_range: deficient Form I perfect being-verb linking the resumed subject to the final predicate
words.root_gloss_range: being, existing, becoming, and remaining; locally established characterization rather than transitive event action

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic subject frame that controls the being-verb
predicate complement assigned by the deficient verb

words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) makes the warrant a characterization. It does not take an object here; as a deficient verb it links the resumed subject from {{ar:إِنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:innahu}}) to {{ar:غَفَّارًۭا}} ({{tr:ghaffāran}}), shifting the semantic weight to the final attribute. The perfect form presents forgivingness as established without making it expired, so the command rests on a settled divine disposition rather than a new reaction. The broader k-w-n field of being and remaining gives that attribute settled placement, and the same kāna-with-forgiveness attribute frame is echoed in 4:96 while the surah's own temporal logic recalls 71:4. Between emphatic subject and intensive predicate, the shared long ā also gives the closing phrase an internal cadence.

topics.headline: deficient verb assigns the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the word is not narrating an action done to an object; it sets the final attribute over the resumed subject.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:غَفَّارًۭا}} ({{tr:ghaffāran}}) as the predicate complement of {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}), with no transitive object.

topics.headline: past establishment without expired mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears forgiveness as an established and still available divine mode, not as a one-time event that has passed.
topics.reason: The perfect deficient verb supports established characterization, and the prompt rows correctly prevent reading past form as expired availability.

topics.headline: being field stabilizes the attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the attribute given settled placement in divine being, while local grammar keeps the verb as a predicate-linking kāna construction.
topics.reason: The k-w-n being and locus images can color the characterization, but local syntax does not license a separate spatial sense.

topics.headline: simple singular being-verb keeps one subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the warrant focused on one resumed divine subject while the simple form leaves the attribute to carry the weight.
topics.reason: The 3ms verb agrees with the pronoun subject in {{ar:إِنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:innahu}}), and its simple Form I profile supports characterization rather than causative action.

topics.headline: recognized kāna-forgiveness frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the final clause as an attribute formula rather than an ad hoc reassurance, with 4:96 as a concrete parallel.
topics.reason: The cited 4:96 parallel and k-w-n plus gh-f-r co-occurrence rows support a formulaic attribute frame, limited by the local predicate {{ar:غَفَّارًۭا}} ({{tr:ghaffāran}}).

topics.headline: kāna mediates assertion and closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the warrant stretched from emphatic subject into final attribute, with cadence binding the closing phrase and 71:4 supplying a same-surah temporal echo.
topics.reason: The word stands between {{ar:إِنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:innahu}}) and {{ar:غَفَّارًۭا}} ({{tr:ghaffāran}}), and the supplied same-surah echo to 71:4 and cadence row are concrete but secondary.

words.gloss_range: indefinite intensive predicate of repeated or abundant forgiving
words.root_gloss_range: covering, shielding, pardoning, and forgiveness; locally intensive divine predicate answering the seeking command

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: deficient verb assigning the final word as predicate
earlier same-root command answered by the closing attribute

words.prose: {{ar:غَفَّارًۭا}} ({{tr:ghaffāran}}) is the ayah's landing word. As the indefinite accusative predicate of {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}), it characterizes the resumed Lord with abundant forgivingness rather than naming a separate object or bare title. Its intensive pattern and doubled sound make the covering capacity repeated and active, answering the exposed liability assumed by {{ar:ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟}} ({{tr:istaghfirū}}). The final position seals the command's rationale: the people are told to seek covering because their Lord is repeatedly one who covers. The final attribute also sits in a repentance-oriented frame echoed at 20:82, while the same root, sound texture, and adjacent -āran closure from 71:9 to 71:10 make divine protective covering the audible structural endpoint.

topics.headline: quality predicate, not separate object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word characterize the one resumed Lord with a quality, not add another object or merely cite a fixed title.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:غَفَّارًۭا}} ({{tr:ghaffāran}}) as the accusative predicate of {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}), and tanwīn supports qualitative predication.

topics.headline: intensive coverer answers liability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the warrant as repeated active covering for exposed fault, while the local predicate remains an intensive forgiving attribute.
topics.reason: The gh-f-r covering field and intensive pattern survive as positive lexical pressure, but the local form is the divine adjective/predicate {{ar:غَفَّارًۭا}} ({{tr:ghaffāran}}).

topics.headline: final attribute answers the command root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the command to seek forgiveness close inside the same root as divine capacity, making the rationale the ayah's final impression.
topics.reason: The ayah begins the quoted command with a gh-f-r imperative and ends with a gh-f-r intensive predicate, so the local root return is explicit.

topics.headline: repentance-oriented attribute frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final attribute participate in a repentance and stable-attribute frame, with 20:82 giving a concrete {{ar:غَفَّار}} ({{tr:ghaffār}}) parallel.
topics.reason: The 20:82 row and k-w-n plus gh-f-r co-occurrence rows support a recognized attribute frame, while the local predicate remains decisive.

topics.headline: the named Lord is the forgiving one
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the final attribute attached to the same singular Lord named in the command, so a specific summons becomes an instance of enduring divine mode.
topics.reason: The masculine singular predicate tracks the resumed divine subject, and the r-b-b plus gh-f-r rows fit the local command-to-warrant logic.

topics.headline: sound and boundary make covering the landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears intensity, root recurrence, and the 71:9 to 71:10 ending pattern converge at the final word.
topics.reason: The shaddah, gh-f-r consonant recurrence, and adjacent -āran boundary row give a concrete sound-structure payoff at the ayah close.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative at word 2 and the intensive predicate at word 6 repeat غ ف ر around ربكم and كان.
baseline_models.mechanism: An uttered communal directive turns the hearers toward their authoritative Lord for a covering that not only hides fault but shields its bearer from the fault's effect; كان presents this capacity as already established in time.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the audible directive and makes the protective turn a publicly actionable command.
Shielding a wrongdoer from a fault's consequence supplies the operative content of both seeking forgiveness and the intensive divine predicate.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the one whose protection can actually govern consequences.
Being and temporal predication make abundant forgiveness an established disposition rather than a newly improvised response.

changed_reading.before: The ayah gives a general instruction to ask God for pardon.
changed_reading.after: The ayah voices a communal move under effective lordship into an already available protection from the consequences of fault.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ربكم at word 3 stands between the request and the assurance, while غ ف ر supplies a preserving cover rather than simple deletion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord is approached as one who repairs, nurtures, and completes. Forgiveness can therefore preserve the faulty person under cover while correction and growth continue, not merely erase an entry from an account.

activation_trace.role: A protective covering supplies preservation through exposure and gives forgiveness a constructive rather than merely subtractive function.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the invoked Lord the agent of rehabilitative care.
The non-dominant mapped image of nurture and growing up reinforces an exploratory developmental dimension in ربكم.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness removes blame for a completed past act.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness is a preserving environment in which the Lord can repair and bring an unfinished people toward completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same root appears in the hearers' imperative استغفروا and in the intensive غفارا, linked by كان.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus construction pairs a repeatable human appeal with an enduringly abundant divine capacity. The command is thus a reusable mode of return rather than a single exceptional petition.

activation_trace.role: The shared shielding image links the requested act and the intensive responder-side capacity into a repeatable relation.
Temporal predication extends the availability of that relation beyond one moment.
Earnest concern makes the directive sustained pastoral intervention rather than detached information.

changed_reading.before: The imperative asks for one act of pardon.
changed_reading.after: The imperative opens a durable practice of return matched by a repeatedly available shielding response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening warning places the focus command before an approaching painful consequence. Seeking forgiveness becomes an urgent movement into protection while a response window remains, not an abstract recommendation about moral improvement.

activation_trace.role: Shielding from consequence anchors the focus command as refuge rather than mere emotional relief.
A warning that awakens caution supplies the advance signal that makes refuge timely and actionable.
Painful punishment supplies the concrete consequence from which the focus covering can protect.
Pain sharpens the threatened outcome and prevents the protective reading from becoming merely figurative comfort.

structural_cues: 71:1 places warning before arrival, whereas 71:10 still addresses the hearers with an imperative.
The focus follows a sequence of attempted invitations, so the remaining response window is narratively pressured.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies advance warning and painful punishment; I infer that the focus shielding is offered before impact. A live alternative is that warning and forgiveness are adjacent appeals without a direct refuge relation.

changed_reading.before: Seek forgiveness is a generally beneficial devotional instruction.
changed_reading.after: Seek forgiveness is the still-open protective action to take before a warned consequence arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier pairing of forgiveness with delay, followed by an appointed limit that does not itself move when it arrives, distinguishes merciful re-spacing from cancellation. The focus offers protected time in which repair can occur.

activation_trace.role: Shielding from a fault's effect anchors the focus promise as meaningful protection.
Temporal predication in the focus supports reading the offered protection across time.
The same shielding image explicitly couples forgiveness to the context's temporal promise.
Delay to a later time supplies the extension in which protected repair remains possible.
A fixed temporal limit bounds reprieve and keeps mercy from being misread as abolition of every endpoint.

structural_cues: 71:4 coordinates forgiveness, delay, and an appointed term before the focus restates forgiveness in 71:10.
The repeated delay root appears positively and then under negation, creating an explicit temporal boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgiveness, delay, and a fixed term; I infer that shielding creates usable time for repair. The live alternative is that forgiveness and delay are parallel benefits rather than one enabling the other.

changed_reading.after: Forgiveness can be bounded reprieve: protection and additional time for repair without denying an appointed limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hearers block receptive hearing, place a cover over themselves, and tighten into insistence precisely when called toward forgiveness. The focus therefore contrasts two coverings: self-enclosure that prevents repair and divine covering that preserves the person from fault's effect.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering supplies the beneficial cover offered by the focus.
The call's explicit aim of shielding from consequence ties the refusal scene directly to the focus imperative.
Listening and accepting what is heard supply the reception interface that the hearers deliberately block.
A cover laid over a thing supplies the rival self-applied enclosure that prevents exposure to the call.
Tight binding turns refusal into a self-sealing mechanism rather than a momentary failure to hear.

structural_cues: 71:7 states that the invitation was made so that they might be forgiven, then sequences blocked ears, covered bodies, insistence, and arrogance.
The branchless finger occurrence in 71:7 structurally intensifies the deliberate sealing of the hearing channel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a forgiveness aim, blocked hearing, self-covering, and tightening; I infer that these form a rival-covering contrast. The alternative is that the bodily gestures only mark generic refusal without interacting with غ ف ر imagery.

changed_reading.before: The hearers merely decline a request for pardon.
changed_reading.after: They choose a self-sealing cover over the protective cover offered by forgiveness, so the imperative asks them to exchange modes of concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calling in overt and hidden modes exhausts the communication channels around the audience. Against that background, فقلت does not introduce a casual remark; it distills the repeated outreach into one portable imperative and one reason.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors the focus as the articulated kernel of the surrounding outreach.
Calling by speech supplies the repeated communicative action from which the focus saying is distilled.
Open declaration and raised voice supply the public channel already attempted.
Concealing speech inwardly supplies the private channel, completing the public-private span.

structural_cues: 71:8-9 move from open calling to both announcement and secrecy immediately before فقلت in 71:10.
The focus message is unusually compact after the preceding communication sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated calling across public and private modes; I infer that the focus saying is their distilled invariant. A live alternative is that فقلت is only the next chronological speech verb with no compression function.

changed_reading.before: So I said is neutral narrative framing for a new sentence.
changed_reading.after: So I said marks the irreducible message carried through every channel: turn for protection because abundant forgiveness is already available.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence after the focus moves through sending, abundant issue from a source, connected extension, and opened channels of flow. Forgiveness reads as removal of obstruction and restoration to circulation; its cover protects without plugging the channels of life.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering anchors the focus and supplies a cover that can preserve while flow resumes.
Repair and nurture make restored circulation part of the Lord's completing care.
Sending and release initiate the outward movement that follows the focus invitation.
Abundant issue from a source supplies sustained, plentiful flow rather than a single drop.
Connected increase that supports another supplies continuation and material reinforcement.
Opening and widening until something flows makes the result a network of unblocked channels.

structural_cues: 71:11-12 follow the forgiveness command directly with coordinated future benefits.
Rain, extension, gardens, and rivers form a material sequence from source to sustained channel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct sequence and multiple flow images; I infer that forgiveness reopens circulation rather than mechanically causing weather. The live alternative is that these are promised signs or rewards without an obstruction-release mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness changes only the moral status of the petitioners.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness restores petitioners to a life-giving circulation of release, extension, and open channels.

context_deltas.mechanism: A covered garden, successive developmental states, human growth like a plant, and return after departure make protective covering incubatory. The focus cover can shelter an unfinished creature through regrowth and repeated transition rather than freeze it in its fault.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering anchors the proposed incubatory environment in the focus word itself.
Nurture and completion give the protected environment a developmental purpose.
A garden hidden by trees supplies a fertile cover in which life flourishes rather than a cover that merely conceals.
Successive states supply the staged path through which repair can mature.
Human growth and nurture make moral restoration analogous to cultivated development.
Return after departure supplies reversibility and keeps a failed state from being the person's final state.

structural_cues: 71:12-18 progress from garden to stages, layered creation, human planting, return, and emergence.
The focus ربكم provides a nurture anchor before the creation-and-growth sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fertile cover, stages, human growth, and return; I infer that the focus covering shelters regeneration. The alternative is that the creation sequence demonstrates power without specifying forgiveness's mode.

changed_reading.after: Forgiveness is a fertile protective cover under which a person can pass through stages, regrow, and return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same wealth named among post-forgiveness extensions appears later inside an increase toward loss, followed by increased wandering. Increase is therefore direction-sensitive. Seeking forgiveness changes the governing relation and redirects capacity; it is not a transaction that guarantees that more possessions are intrinsically good.

activation_trace.role: Lordship supplies the governing orientation under which increase can be ordered toward preservation rather than loss.
Increase and growth supply the neutral amplifier whose outcome depends on its direction.
Accumulated wealth first appears as an extension after the forgiveness call, establishing its potentially supportive use.
The same wealth image later occupies a loss-producing relation, proving that possession alone does not determine the result.
General diminution supplies the adverse direction into which uncorrected increase runs.
Wandering from guidance supplies the directional error that further increase amplifies.

structural_cues: 71:12 coordinates wealth and children with extension, while 71:21 coordinates wealth and offspring with increased loss.
The repeated increase construction in 71:6, 71:21, 71:24, and 71:28 repeatedly marks directional amplification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same asset under opposed outcomes and repeats increase toward flight, loss, error, and destruction; I infer that forgiveness reorients the amplifier. The alternative is that the passages contrast different owners without proposing a general direction mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The benefits after forgiveness imply that prosperity itself is the sign and goal of pardon.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness redirects what increase does; even wealth can nourish or corrode depending on the relation governing it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fault proceeds to comprehensive engulfment, forced entry, and absence of aid. This downstream sequence gives the focus's shielding image a concrete causal edge: forgiveness protects the person from a fault becoming an environment that wholly contains them.

activation_trace.role: Shielding the wrongdoer from the fault's effect anchors the focus as interruption of consequence.
Sin and fault supply the initiating condition whose effect the focus cover addresses.
Comprehensive engulfment supplies the totalizing consequence of remaining unshielded.
Entry into an interior turns consequence from an external threat into a containing condition.
Aid and making manifest, explicitly absent in the ayah, mark the lost rescue that the earlier protective opening had offered.

structural_cues: 71:25 uses causal wording from faults to engulfment and then sequences entry and failure to find helpers.
The passive verbs make the people recipients of the consequence after their earlier refusal to act on the focus imperative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fault, causal sequence, engulfment, entry, and absent aid; I infer that forgiveness would interrupt the fault-to-environment transition. The alternative is that shielding concerns accountability without specifying where this sequence would be interrupted.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness offers relief from an unspecified penalty.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness interrupts the process by which fault becomes a total environment that engulfs and contains the wrongdoer without aid.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final prayer repeats forgiveness while widening its relational scope from self and parents to an entrant, a household threshold, and all believing men and women. The plural command in the focus thus opens not only individual pardon but entry into a widening shelter of trust and solidarity.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering anchors the focus invitation as shelter capable of communal extension.
Nurture and completion keep the shelter relational rather than merely spatial.
The repeated request for shielding applies the focus action to named concentric relations.
Entry into an interior supplies the threshold movement from exposure into protected relation.
Dwelling and shelter give the widening forgiven community a concrete spatial center.
Inner security and trust describe the condition of those entering and extending beyond the house.

structural_cues: 71:28 expands from first-person prayer through parents and a house entrant to believing men and women.
The surah closes by repeating رب and غ ف ر from the focus, turning the earlier plural invitation into the speaker's own intercessory practice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated forgiveness, entry, dwelling, trust, and widening grammatical scope; I infer a shelter network rather than a list of unrelated beneficiaries. The alternative is that the house is only biographical location and the list only enumerates recipients.

changed_reading.before: The plural command addresses separate individuals who should each seek pardon.
changed_reading.after: The command invites people into a widening protected relation whose trust can extend from person to household to community.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it places distinct roots in a shared material field of covering; it remains valid because the focus غ ف ر and context ك ف ر inventories explicitly supply protective covering and truth-blocking covering. Downstream prose should present it as a controlled branch-image contrast, not as cognation, lexical equivalence, or a definitive interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus repeats غ ف ر as sought protection and abundant divine capacity; 71:27 supplies the intensive كَفَّارًا as the opposed context endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering supplies a cover that preserves the exposed person.
Shielding from consequence makes the beneficial direction of the focus covering explicit.
Covering supplies the shared material image while leaving its moral direction open.
Blocking truth turns the context covering into the inverse of the focus's protective exposure and repair.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness and denial are unrelated moral labels.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the surah asks which covering will govern the person: one that blocks truth or one that shields consequence while allowing repair.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising and form-distant because it activates the packet's non-dominant ق ل ل mapping for focus ق و ل; it remains anchored to word 1 and gains context from repeated public and private calling. Downstream prose must label it a split-root branch experiment, not ordinary morphology or the primary sense of فقلت.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 فقلت is the exact focus occurrence whose packet mapping includes non-dominant images of smallness and lifting.

activation_trace.role: Fewness and smallness make the short focus utterance a compact remainder after extensive calling.
Carrying, lifting, and rising let the compact saying function experimentally as a lever toward renewed response.
Repeated calling by speech supplies the broad communicative effort against which the small focus utterance is measured.
Open declaration supplies one expanded mode that the compact imperative carries forward.
Hidden speech supplies the opposite expanded mode, leaving the focus sentence as their concise common payload.

changed_reading.before: فقلت only reports that another statement was spoken.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root experiment, a small utterance carries and lifts the essential invitation after larger communicative efforts have failed.

strongest_changes: Forgiveness became a timely protective refuge and bounded reprieve rather than generic cancellation.
The self-covering refusal in 71:7 exposed a conflict between a cover that seals people off and a cover that preserves them for repair.
The flow sequence in 71:11-12 and the opposed outcomes of increase in 71:21-24 made forgiveness a reorientation into life-giving circulation, not a prosperity transaction.
The final prayer in 71:28 widened the focus plural into a sheltering relation from person to household to community.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly changed the function of covering: it could shield consequence, seal hearing, hide a fertile garden, block truth, or define a dwelling. Those contrasts made the focus غ ف ر materially active while ربكم kept the mechanism under nurturing authority.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from forgiveness to reopened ecological and material flow is sequence-based and may instead mark promised signs or rewards.
The regenerative-cover model depends on a cross-domain analogy among protective cover, garden concealment, staged growth, and return.
The smallness-and-lifting outlier relies on a non-dominant split-root mapping and must remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Seeking forgiveness means entering a sustained reparative cover.** **غ ف ر B002** supplies pardon and shielding from consequence, **ر ب ب B002** repair and stage-by-stage nurture, and **ك و ن B001** continuing being or temporal predication. The imperative is followed by the intensive *ghaffāran* as an established divine description. The packet supplies request, nurture, and enduring predication; the abductive arrow is that forgiveness restores people into an ongoing process of repair. The ayah reads as an invitation into a stable remedial relation, not a one-time cancellation.

2. **The commanded cover reverses the self-made cover.** **غ ف ر B001** is protective covering, while 71:7 supplied **غ ش و B001** self-veiling and **ث و ب B003** clothing. The structural cue is Noah’s move from describing their covering to commanding a different kind. The inferred arrow is that acknowledgment opens a cover against consequence, whereas denial closes perception. The ayah’s forgiveness language is materially sharpened by that reversal.

3. **The plural request can gather the entire crowd.** **غ ف ر B008** supplies the idiom of the whole crowd coming together with none left behind. The fixed ayah addresses a plural, and 71:28 later expands forgiveness from Noah and his parents to house-entering believers, men and women. The crowd-scope is lexical but its communal role here is abductive. The ayah can thus be heard as a collective summons toward comprehensive inclusion under forgiveness, alongside the direct **B002** sense.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 71:28 surprisingly answered the plural imperative with an explicitly widening forgiveness-prayer. Its movement through self, parents, household entrant, and all believing men and women made the crowd-gathering undertone of **غ ف ر B008** retrospectively functional.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Forgiveness as generative protection.** **Lexical evidence:** `غ ف ر B001` is protective covering and `غ ف ر B002` is shielding from a sin's consequence; the root is doubled in `ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا` and `غَفَّارًا`. **Structural cue:** within 71:5-15, human garment-covering at 71:7 is replaced by forgiveness, then an overhead sky releases rain at 71:11 and life-support at 71:12. **Assigned role:** forgiveness removes harmful exposure and restores access to a productive environment. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies the sequence; I infer that forgiveness enables, rather than mechanically purchases, restored flourishing. **Reading change:** seeking forgiveness becomes re-entry into protection that generates life.

2. **The Lord as stage-by-stage cultivator.** **Lexical evidence:** `ر ب ب B002` is repair, nurture, and completion stage by stage; 71:14 uses `ط و ر B004` for successive stages of creation. **Structural cue:** `رَبَّكُمْ` stands before rain, wealth, offspring, gardens, and measured creation. **Assigned role:** lordship administers growth through successive provisions rather than only issuing authority. **Abductive move:** I infer that the material and developmental sequence specifies how nurturing lordship operates. **Reading change:** `ربكم` reads as the one who can restore and cultivate a damaged life-system.

3. **Speech joined by nonverbal indication.** **Lexical evidence:** `ق و ل B001` anchors Noah's utterance, while dormant `ق و ل B014` is a thing's “saying” through indication. **Structural cue:** Noah's statement is followed by material and cosmic signs in 71:11-15. **Assigned role:** spoken instruction names what rain, growth, stages, and layered heavens then indicate. **Abductive move:** I infer that the created sequence functions as corroborating, nonverbal discourse. **Reading change:** `فقلت` begins a multi-channel disclosure rather than an isolated proposition.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The measured stages at 71:14 and layered heavens at 71:15 made `ر ب ب B002` visibly developmental: repair and nurture proceed by proportioned phases. They also confirmed dormant `ق و ل B014`, because created order becomes the nonverbal indication that corroborates Noah's spoken call.

baseline.text: Dedim ki: Rabbinizden bağışlanma dileyin; çünkü O çok bağışlayıcıdır.

findings.text: Bağışlanma istemek, tek seferlik silinmeden öte, Rabbin aşama aşama onardığı sürekli bir koruma ilişkisine yeniden girmek olarak belirginleşir.
Bu buyruk, daha önceki kendini örtme hareketini tersine çevirir: inkârın örtüsü algıyı kapatırken bağışlanmanın örtüsü kişiyi sonuca karşı korur.
Bağışlama kökündeki kimseyi geride bırakmadan bütün kalabalığın toplanması çağrışımı, son ayette genişleyen bağışlanma duasıyla toplu bir kapsama dönüşür.
Nuh'un sözünü izleyen yağmur, büyüme ve gök düzeni, söze yaratılmış şeylerin sözsüz işaretinin de katıldığı çok kanallı bir bildirim oluşturur.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 71:1-14] The Summons Reaches a Closing Horizon
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A communicated danger is already in motion, while mercy opens a bounded interval before its arrival.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The warning behaves at once like an approaching assailant, a maturing liability, and an account whose allotted share returns to its bearer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Consequence returns as an allotted due
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An offense creates a due share or binding obligation; its consequence returns to the actor unless forgiveness covers it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: offense with an ominous outcome (`quranic:root_000521:B001/m01`); trailing end of a thing (`quranic:root_000521:B002/m01`); followers attached to a leader (`quranic:root_000521:B003/m01`); allotted share, especially of punishment (`quranic:root_000521:B006/m01`); full bucket as a measured allotment (`quranic:root_000521:B007/m01`); recompense returning to its worker (`quranic:root_000209:B002/m01`); self-imposed binding vow (`quranic:root_001488:B002/m01`); wound carrying a legally due compensation (`quranic:root_001488:B003/m01`); written guarantee and surety (`quranic:root_001198:B008/m01`); appointed maturity (`quranic:root_000016:B001/m01`); punitive affliction (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); forgiveness that shields the offender from effect (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The warning acquires the structure of a due account. Sin trails an act like a tail and gathers adherent consequences like followers; it can be an allotted bucket, warning can name a voluntarily or legally binding obligation, and recompense is what comes back from an act. Surety makes the liability transferable and enforceable, while forgiveness intervenes before its return by covering both fault and punitive effect.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 71:1-14] Covering Can Refuse Exposure or Convert It Into Safety
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A cover changes the relation between an exposed subject and what reaches it, either by blocking reception or by shielding from harm.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same material logic that makes a garment into an acoustic barricade also makes forgiveness a protective cover and a garden a habitable enclosure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Pardoning cover interposes a shield against consequence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fault remains real, but a preserving layer covers it and stands between the offender and its damaging return.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: general covering that preserves (`quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`); forgiveness shielding from the effect of sin (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`); offense with a harmful outcome (`quranic:root_000521:B001/m01`); protective shield (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); barrier that repels injury (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); placing oneself in protection (`quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`); restraint and withholding (`quranic:root_000994:B003/m01`); garment as protective covering (`quranic:root_000209:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Forgiveness does not erase the causal scene by denial; it inserts a preserving layer. Shield, garment, restraint, and pardoning cover all modify exposure to harm. This reverses the crowd's operation: they cover themselves from the message, while the offered cover would protect them from the consequence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 71:1-14] Covering Can Refuse Exposure or Convert It Into Safety

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A covered interior becomes a productive refuge
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Enclosure progresses from a hidden interior and defensive screen to a garden whose dense vegetation shelters and sustains life.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: concealment from perception (`quranic:root_000266:B001/m01`); tree-covered garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); defensive screen (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); hidden heart or interior (`quranic:root_000266:B010/m01`); dense, surging vegetation (`quranic:root_000266:B011/m01`); place of concealment (`quranic:root_000266:B017/m01`); preserving cover (`quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`); tent-like screen (`quranic:root_001315:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: These motifs form a spatial transformation rather than a list of coverings. A hidden interior gains a defensive perimeter; that perimeter becomes a place of refuge; and thick vegetation turns refuge into a garden. The promised garden thus extends the logic of merciful covering into an inhabitable and fertile world.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 71:1-14] Command Tests Whether the Human Becomes Traversable
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Response to command is figured as a change in resistance: yielding makes action smooth and passable, while refusal produces knots, stiffness, and upward competitive pressure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Obedience is not only a social posture; it is a road made level, a rein made responsive, and fruit made ready to gather.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Worship aligns authority, will, and action
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A sovereign command is recognized, accepted, and carried through by a subject whose will moves with it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deity and worship (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`); lordship, ownership, and command (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); servitude and owned status (`quranic:root_000973:B001/m01`); worship as humbled obedience (`quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`); bringing another under service (`quranic:root_000973:B004/m01`); willing obedience (`quranic:root_000956:B001/m01`); agreement and responsive following (`quranic:root_000956:B002/m01`); capacity to carry out action (`quranic:root_000956:B003/m01`); voluntary contribution beyond obligation (`quranic:root_000956:B005/m01`); self made ready for an act (`quranic:root_000956:B006/m01`); self-protective piety (`quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Authority, subjecthood, willingness, and execution occupy distinct roles. Worship names the relation, obedience supplies motion, capacity makes the act possible, and piety keeps the subject within protection. The scene therefore joins hierarchy to an internally consenting mechanism rather than reducing obedience to external compliance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene moves from inward fastening to outward rivalry. The will knots, the body contracts, the load grows heavy, and refusal seeks a higher rank from which to contest the command. Pride is thus the final mechanical state of accumulated resistance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Supply moves through a causal system from elevated release, to capture and routing, to biological and economic increase.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Rain is rendered not as atmosphere alone but as a complete infrastructure: cloud reservoir, discharge, basin, channel, productive estate, and circulating surplus.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: An elevated reservoir releases a sustained discharge
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water gathers above, is released from its source, and descends in a repeated abundant flow.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sky, cloud, and overhead cover (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); layered rain-bearing cloud (`quranic:root_000532:B008/m01`); cloud mass (`quranic:root_001559:B008/m01`); sending and release (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`); abundant outflow from a source (`quranic:root_000469:B001/m01`); successive milk-like flow (`quranic:root_000563:B006/m01`); sky-exposed state (`quranic:root_000994:B004/m01`); circular turbulent water (`quranic:root_000469:B008/m01`); cloud-ring or encircling mass (`quranic:root_001315:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene is hydraulic: an overhead cover holds a cloud mass, dispatch releases it, and abundant outflow supplies the process. The milk sense gives repeated rain the function of nourishment drawn continuously from a source.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A formed being emerges through prior measure, joined structure, staged transition, and sustained maturation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human creation is materialized as tailoring, architecture, bodily support, gestation, and gradual upbringing rather than a single instantaneous event.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Measure becomes a joined and supported form
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A form is estimated, brought into existence, assembled from parts, and stabilized by internal supports.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prior estimating and measuring (`quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`); originating a created thing (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`); completed and proportioned form (`quranic:root_000434:B003/m01`); inward disposition (`quranic:root_000434:B004/m01`); making and bringing into being (`quranic:root_000248:B001/m01`); placing into a condition (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`); construction by joining parts (`quranic:root_000156:B001/m01`); composite constitution (`quranic:root_000156:B002/m01`); ribs and structural props (`quranic:root_000156:B009/m01`); corresponding pieces joined face-to-face (`quranic:root_001198:B010/m01`); sustaining framework (`quranic:root_001273:B009/m01`); upright component or implement (`quranic:root_001273:B012/m01`); occurrence in existence (`quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Creation has the internal sequence of craft. Estimation precedes production; production joins parts; joined parts receive ribs, props, and an upright frame; and the result takes a completed outward form and inward disposition. The body is read as a measured construction whose coherence is made.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Hidden gestation produces offspring whose bodies, capacities, and social place are gradually sustained into maturity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fetus concealed in the womb (`quranic:root_000266:B007/m01`); lineage and offspring (`quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`); food building flesh (`quranic:root_000156:B010/m01`); repair, completion, and gradual upbringing (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); foster child and caregiver (`quranic:root_000532:B005/m01`); recent birth and maternal staying (`quranic:root_000532:B009/m01`); pregnancy nearing delivery (`quranic:root_000548:B005/m01`); midwife receiving the emerging child (`quranic:root_001198:B007/m01`); womb and post-birth discharge (`quranic:root_000994:B009/m01`); growth and yield (`quranic:root_000009:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The hidden beginning is followed by delivery, nourishment, fostered care, and bodily growth. Creation therefore continues through relational labor after emergence. The parental and pastoral vocabulary makes staged creation a sustained economy of care.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Collective identity depends on a governing relation that gathers and tends members; rejection reverses that gathering into dispersal.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The people addressed as a social body are also legible as a tended herd whose keeper supplies pasture, water, and milk, yet whose response is to bolt and fragment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Community is assembled by relation and care
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Individuals become a people through kinship, gathering, governance, and the care that maintains their common life.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: human community and kin group (`quranic:root_001273:B001/m01`); settled gathering or council (`quranic:root_001273:B006/m01`); guardianship and governance (`quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`); sustaining framework of communal life (`quranic:root_001273:B009/m01`); large gathered groups (`quranic:root_000532:B004/m01`); sovereign owner and caretaker (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); group facing one another (`quranic:root_001198:B009/m01`); public assembly (`quranic:root_000269:B006/m01`); mass of the people (`quranic:root_000266:B013/m01`); whole crowd without remainder (`quranic:root_001096:B008/m01`); assembled groups (`quranic:root_001315:B009/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Community is not mere numerical plurality. Facing, council, shared lineage, governance, and maintenance gather members into a body. The repeated address “my people” therefore invokes an organized relation whose integrity the warning tries to preserve.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A keeper gathers animals, releases them in ordered groups, provides water and milk, and holds them in usable pasture.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: wild herd gathered as one (`quranic:root_000016:B004/m01`); stock retained in pasture (`quranic:root_000016:B008/m01`); herd of cattle or camels (`quranic:root_000532:B014/m01`); successive groups sent to pasture or water (`quranic:root_000563:B005/m01`); repeated milk supply (`quranic:root_000563:B006/m01`); residual milk drawing the next flow (`quranic:root_000478:B003/m01`); watering directly at the animals' mouths (`quranic:root_001198:B014/m01`); pasture opened and fruit made available (`quranic:root_000956:B007/m01`); herd or flock (`quranic:root_001674:B006/m01`); young animal following its dam (`quranic:root_001142:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: This is a husbandry mechanism with keeper, herd, release, feeding ground, water, and milk. It gives the divine provision a pastoral form: restraint is used for care, release is ordered, and recurring nourishment draws more nourishment.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol iri küpün yanı sıra küpün yerleştirildiği tahta destekleri de kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da çok büyük bir küpü veya fıçımsı saklama kabını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kap nesnesinde güçlü bir örtüşme vardır; bu kol ölçü değerine uzanırken komşu kol kabın yerleştirildiği desteği de kapsayan farklı bir sınır kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol kabın özellikle iri oluşunu ve iki kaplık ölçü değerini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol genel bir küp veya saklama kabını büyüklük koşulu olmadan adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da küp biçimindeki büyükçe saklama kapları için kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda büyük kapasite kurucu bir özelliktir; komşu kartta kap türü öndedir ve aynı ölçü uzantısı bulunmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol büyük bir küpü ve ona dayalı kapasite ölçüsünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol bir şeyin başını, tepesini veya en üst bölümünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri hacimli bir kap ve onun ölçüsüdür; diğeri bir varlığın uzamsal olarak en üstteki parçasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; büyük küp anlamına en yakın iki kap komşusu ile aynı kökteki tepe anlamından ayrım, sınırı göstermek için yeterli ve yinelenmeyen karşılaştırmalardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.text: yük kaldırma, yükselme ve yola koyulma
concept_gloss.applicability: Taşıma, yukarı kalkma ve yüklenerek hareket etme çizgilerinin birlikte özetlenmesi gereken kavram haritasında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yük üstlenme, yükselme ve yolculuk için harekete geçme bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin veya başka bir taşıyıcının bir nesnenin ağırlığını üstlenmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yükü kaldırma gücü ile onu fiilen taşıma anlamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Göğün yükselmesi veya kuşun uçuşa kalkması gibi yukarı yönlü hareket bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yukarı kalkma ile uçuş için yerden ayrılma değerlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun yolculuk yüklerini alarak bulunduğu yerden ayrılması bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yük alma, ayrılma ve yolculuğa başlama aşamalarını birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol yükü taşımanın yanında yükselme, havalanma ve yüklenerek ayrılma anlamlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yükü taşıma eyleminden çok onu taşıyacak güce sahip olmayı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir yükün ağırlığını karşılayacak gücü ve taşıma yeterliğini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Taşıma yeterliği ortak olsa da bu kol fiilî taşıma ve yerden yükselme yönlerine açılır; komşu kol güç yetirme sınırında kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol yük üstlenmeyi, kuşun havalanmasını ve yolcuların yüklenerek ayrılmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol kişinin oturduğu yerden kalkmasını ve bir nesneyi bulunduğu yerden kaldırmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da aşağıdaki veya durağan bir konumdan kalkma ve hareket başlangıcını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol yükselmeyi taşıma ve yolculukla bağlar; komşu kol bedensel olarak ayağa kalkma ve nesneyi yerinden kaldırma çevresindedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolda yolculuk anlamı yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılmasıyla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yol üzerinde ilerlemeyi ve belirli bir hedefe doğru seyahat etmeyi genel olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlama durumunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol başlangıçtaki yüklenme ve kalkış anını anlatır; komşu kol yolculuğun kendisini ve hedefe doğru ilerlemeyi çekirdek edinir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; taşıma gücü, yerden kalkma ve yolculuğa başlama komşuları bu kolun üç kurucu yönünü en az yinelemeyle açıklar.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد القلة العددية، ولا قلة الجبل، ولا الرعدة
branches.source_phrase_ar: أقل الجرة أطاق حملها؛ استقلت السماء ارتفعت؛ استقل القوم مضوا وارتحلوا (sihah)؛ أقل الرجل الشيء واستقله إذا احتمله؛ استقل الطائر إذا نهض للطيران؛ استقل النبات أناف؛ استقل القوم إذا احتملوا ظاعنين؛ أقلت سحابا ثقالا أي حملت؛ قل إذا رفع وقل إذا علا (tahdhib)؛ أقلت سحابا ثقالا أي احتملته؛ أقللت كذا وجدته قليل المحمل (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duygusal nedeni ve bedensel titremeyi birlikte taşıyan bütün kol için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun yol açtığı kısa ve istemsiz bedensel titreme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Korkuya bağlı istemsiz titreme ve silkiniş hissini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Titremenin kişiyi birden tutan belirgin bir durum olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Titremenin kişiyi tutan bedensel bir olay olarak sunuluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öfkenin bedensel titreme halinde dışa vurulduğu kişi bağlamlarına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Öfke nedenini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan titremeyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol titremenin korku veya öfkeden doğmasını anlam sınırının parçası yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol insandaki titreme veya silkinişi belirli bir duygusal nedenle sınırlamaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da insan bedeninde ortaya çıkan titreme veya silkinişi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bedensel olay aynıdır; bu kol korku ve öfke koşulunu taşırken komşu kart neden bakımından daha genel kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol korkunun yanında öfkeyi de titremenin belirleyici nedeni olarak içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol hastalık, gevşeklik, yumuşaklık ve korkaklıkla ilişkili titremeleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da özellikle korku sırasında insanda görülen titreme ve ürpermede örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Korkuya bağlı kullanımda yakınlaşırlar; bu kol öfkeyi ekler, komşu kol ise hastalık ve bedensel gevşeklik gibi başka nedenlere açılır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; genel insan titremesi ve nedenleri daha geniş ürperme alanı, bu kolun kişi ve duygu sınırını en iyi gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Neden olunan hareketi ve nesnenin ortaya çıkan kararsız sallanmasını birlikte kapsayan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket ettirme nedenini ve sabit kalamayan nesnenin sallanma sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bir nesneyi hareket ettirerek onun oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dışarıdan uygulanan hareketi ve nesnenin sarsılması sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin gevşeklik veya kararsızlık nedeniyle bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sabit kalamama ile düzensiz sallanma durumunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sallanan veya oynayan nesnenin çıkardığı sesin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin genel bir ses değil, hareketten doğan işitsel belirti oluşunu korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi örtmeyi, örtülen şeyi kirden ya da zarardan korumayı ve başlık, bez, bulut, kap ile ilgili özel gerçekleşmeleri birlikte destekler. Bu nedenle dalın koruyarak örtme çerçevesi kaynak anlamını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği fiziksel ya da işlevsel örtme ve korumadır; suçun bağışlanması, hastalığın kötüleşmesi ve öteki eş adlı anlamlar buna katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak örtme çekirdeği ile başlık, bez, bulut ve belirli söz öbeklerine bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur; özel kullanımlar bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi örterek görünürlükten, kirden ya da zarardan korumak ve bu işi gören örtü veya koruyucu katmanı belirtmektir. Bazı kullanımlar, eşyayı kaba koyma ya da bir işi gereken biçimde örtüp düzeltme gibi belirli yapılara bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi örterek onu dış etkiden korumak ya da görünmez kılmaktır.
Başı koruyan zırh başlığı, başörtüsünü yağdan sakınan bez, yay çentiğindeki yama ve başka bir bulutu örten bulut bu çekirdeğin özel örnekleridir.
Eşyayı bir kaba koyma, kumaşı kiri daha iyi gizler duruma getirme ve bir işi uygun biçimde örtüp düzeltme yalnızca belirtilen yapılarda geçerlidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar örtme ile korumayı ortak çekirdek sayar; koruyucu başlık ve çeşitli bez ya da örtü türleri bu çekirdeği somutlaştırırken kap, kumaş ve iş düzenleme kullanımları belirli yapılara bağlı kalır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Örtme işlemi ile örtülen şeyi koruma sonucunun birlikte bulunduğu genel çekirdek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem örtme işlemini hem de kir, zarar veya görünürlük karşısındaki koruyucu işlevi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin üstünü kapatma eyleminin aynı zamanda onu koruduğu fiil bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çekirdekteki örtme işlemini ve bunun koruyucu sonucunu birlikte verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Baş, kumaş, yay çentiği ya da benzeri bir yüzey üstündeki koruyucu nesne anlatılırken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Örtünün koruma işlevini ve üstte duran katman olmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Eylem anlamını ve yalnızca belirli söz yapılarında görülen kap ya da düzeltme kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Örtmenin nesneyi kirden ya da zarardan koruma amacı ve belirli koruyucu nesneleri öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin üstüne konan her türlü örtüyü, koruma sonucu zorunlu olmadan daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyi üstten kapatma işlemini veya bu işi gören örtüyü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında örtme ile koruyup sakınma bağı kurucudur; komşu dalda ise üstünü kapatma yeterlidir ve koruyucu sonuç zorunlu değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Koruyucu başlık, bez ve benzeri araçlarda örtmenin nesneyi korumasını özellikle içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Duyudan gizlenmeyi, kişinin bir şeyle saklanmasını ve içte saklanan düşünceyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın ortak alanı bir şeyi görünürlükten çıkaran örtme işlemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı koruyan bir örtüyü ve koruma sonucunu öne çıkarır; komşu dal gizlenme ve içte saklama yönünde daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Somut ya da işlevsel bir örtüyle nesneyi kirden, zarardan veya görünürlükten korur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir suçu bağışlayıp kişiyi cezanın etkisinden koruyan ahlaki ve dinsel işlemi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da olumsuz bir etkinin kişiye ya da nesneye ulaşmasını önleme düşüncesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalının çekirdeği örtme eylemidir; komşu dalda konu suç ve cezadır, fiziksel bir örtü kurucu anlam taşımaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel örtme, gizlenme ve suçtan koruma ile en kolay karışabilecek üç sınır yayımlandı, yalnızca ortak senaryo taşıyan öteki dallar elendi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أصل الستر والتغطية والصون، وما يغطي الرأس أو الخمار أو الوتر أو السحاب، وجعل المتاع في وعاء أو جعل الثوب أحمل للوسخ.
